# Introduction
## Dataset description
This dataset includes ~24 years of data (2000-2024) for over 200 countries including different health indicators.This dataset's rows represent each country and year combination collected and has regional classifications that will be used in the grouping of data.

## Analysis objectives
My final project will be comparing regional trends in mortality and overall well-being using health indicators over the 24 year span of the dataset.


# Descriptive Data
## Table 1
```{r, table, echo=FALSE}

table_one <- readRDS(here::here("output", "table_one.rds"))
table_one

```
Table 1 shows the distribution of Income Level by Region in the year 2000. The levels are Lower Income, Low Income, Upper Middle Income, High Income, and Unclassified. 

## Figure 1
Figuere 1 shows the average life expectancy in years by region in the year 2000. The average ranges from 54 to 78 years.
```{r, figure 1, echo=FALSE}

figure1 <- readRDS(here::here("output", "figure1.rds"))

figure1

```
